item.name: World Estimating
item.description: Construction cost estimating and material takeoff provider offering single-trade takeoffs, monthly estimator retainers and Xactimate insurance claim estimates.

mainEntity.name: Does World Estimating provide shop drawings, renderings or permit sets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Based on their public page sitemap reviewed on 2026-09-03, World Estimating publishes no pages for shop drawings, 3D rendering or permit sets. Their published scope is cost estimating, material takeoffs, CPM scheduling and Xactimate insurance claim estimates. The ACE Services provides all three as dedicated services alongside estimating.

World Estimating publishes rates: approximately $200 for a single-trade takeoff, under $100 for small scopes, and a dedicated estimator retainer starting at $1,500 per month covering 10 to 15 typical jobs, as listed on their pricing page on 2026-09-03. The ACE Services quotes per project based on square footage, scope complexity and documentation quality, and provides a free preliminary quote and a public cost calculator. For a single-trade takeoff, a published flat rate is usually the lower-cost route.

mainEntity.name: Do both companies deliver in 24 to 48 hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both state a 24 to 48 hour standard turnaround. World Estimating notes their turnaround depends on scope of work and does not apply to complex projects. The ACE Services delivers AACE Class 3 estimates with CSI MasterFormat cost breakdowns in Excel and PDF within the same window, with larger multi-discipline packages quoted individually.

mainEntity.name: Which one handles insurance or damage claim estimates?

acceptedAnswer.text: World Estimating offers Xactimate estimating and damage claim estimate services. The ACE Services does not currently offer insurance restoration estimating.

mainEntity.name: Can a contractor use both providers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The two have limited overlap outside core estimating. Contractors needing high-volume single-trade takeoffs at a published rate, or insurance claim work, are well served by a specialist. Projects that also require coordinated shop drawings, client-facing renderings or a stamped permit set are better handled by a single multi-discipline provider.
